name: UK Housing Data Standards
tagline: Sector-developed data standards for UK social housing to improve data governance, performance, and regulatory reporting
known_funders: OSCRE (Open Standards Consortium for Real Estate)
dependency_risks: OSCRE partnership for ongoing standard development
Continuity of HACT as charity organisation

news_articles.headline: HACT updates UK Housing Data Standards to focus on feedback and complaints

academic_citations.title: Overheating investigation in UK social housing flats built to the Passivhaus standard
Analysis of retrofit air source heat pump performance: Results from detailed simulations and comparison to field trial data
Measuring fuel poverty in France: Which households are the most fuel vulnerable?

policy_outcomes.description: Better Social Housing Review panel recommended all housing associations adopt the HACT UK Housing Data Standards sector-wide
Awaab's Law data model proof of concept developed using the standards framework to support compliance with regulations due October 2025

outcome_methodology: Sector adoption tracking; download counts; qualitative case studies
published_performance_metrics: Downloaded over 2,000 times by social housing organisations; 100+ housing associations and software companies involved in development
documented_limitations: Adoption remains voluntary with no mandatory enforcement mechanism
Implementation requires 3-5 year strategies for full adoption
Primarily applicable to UK social housing sector
failure_modes: Low implementation rates despite high download numbers
Fragmentation if organisations implement partial modules inconsistently
governance_model: Joint IP ownership between HACT and OSCRE; Creative Commons licence; developed with input from 70+ housing associations
curation_criteria: Developed collaboratively with 17+ housing providers in initial phase, expanded to 70+ organisations across five iterations since 2018
contributor_governance: Sector consultation process for new versions; working groups with housing associations and software companies
community_ownership: IP co-owned by HACT and OSCRE; standards freely available under Creative Commons licence

government_partnerships.partner: Regulator of Social Housing (implicit via Awaab's Law compliance framework)
